scenarios.title: Document integrity: move scenes and create image lineage
expectedOutcomes: Entry A and cue A move together to scene B, and cue B shifts from [0,1000] to [1000,2000]. Reusing the rejected destination-move command ID succeeds once with exactly the three expected version-two items, sequence two, timing two and the exact before/after event; both earlier rejected moves leave the full public document and history unchanged.

Missing and wrong-kind predecessor references and image character tags reject with 400 invalid_reference; self, equal and decreasing revisions reject with 400 image_version. A valid version-two revision followed by its version-one predecessor in the same command succeeds with exact saved items and references, sequence three, unchanged timing two and one exact event. Both image item versions are one, distinct from their data.version values; all rejected attempts preserve the full public snapshot excluding leases and event stream.

The unsupported predecessor ID invalid/id rejects with 400 invalid_id, exact replay preserves the repaired move, and deletion of the predecessor while its revision survives returns 409 item_in_use; each preserves the complete expected public snapshot excluding leases and event stream.
